[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sencha Naturals is a good fit for calming and focusing tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for brewing sencha green tea:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Water temperature: 160°F (71°C) to 170°F (77°C).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Use one teaspoon of loose-leaf sencha tea or one sencha green tea bag for every 8 oz (237ml) of water.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Steep for 1-2 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Use a teapot or tea infuser; warm the teapot before adding tea leaves.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Use fresh, filtered water.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Avoid over-steeping to prevent bitterness.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Experiment with steeping times and ratios.

[PREFERENCE] User has been using a 1:15 coffee-to-water ratio but recently switched to 1:17.  
[PREFERENCE] User thinks the 1:17 ratio has made a huge difference in flavor.
